The '''Tythos River Delta''' was a delta in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], where the northern end of the [[Tythos River]] emptied out into a lake.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> an ill-tempered [[guid]] in the delta was driven mad by an unknown [[Disease|ailment]] and came to pose a threat to others, including its own kind. Members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] then put it down for everyones safety.<ref name="IllTempered">{{TORcite|type=dynamic|Ill-Tempered Guid|[[Tython/Legends|Tython]]}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}
